skill.onslaught.desc: Unleashes a rapid series of 6 strikes against a single enemy.
skill.death_enrage.desc: Enters a furious frenzy, unleashing a deadly series of 9 strikes on all enemies.
skill.share_tempo.desc: Shares momentum with the whole team, boosting all allies' agility (AGI).
skill.final_strike.desc: Channels all momentum into a single devastating blow (ATK × 8).
skill.rousing_tune.desc: Plays an inspiring tune, boosting a chosen ally's attack power.
skill.sea_chant.desc: Chants a maritime shanty, with a 50% chance to silence a chosen enemy.
skill.aerial_strike.desc: An aerial strike on a single enemy that deals both physical and magical damage.
skill.dive_attack.desc: Dives into an enemy with tremendous force, dealing 1.5× normal damage.
skill.smoke_cloud.desc: Releases a thick cloud of smoke at an enemy, with a 50% chance to blind them.
skill.reckless_blow.desc: An incredibly powerful blow dealing 25,000 to 50,000 fixed damage (higher values are increasingly rare), but hits only 8% of the time.
skill.double_throw.desc: Unleashes two quick strikes against a single enemy.
skill.hearty_meal.desc: Restores an ally's health by MAT × 4 HP. Can also be used from the menu.
skill.leap_series.desc: Unleashes a series of 5 rapid strikes on an enemy, with a 4% chance to stun per hit.
skill.lullaby.desc: Delivers 9 light strikes in rhythm, with a 70% chance to put the enemy to sleep on each hit.
skill.nurturing_care.desc: Bolsters a chosen ally, increasing their defense.
skill.piercing_shriek.desc: Attacks a single enemy with a 15% chance to inflict poison. Deals more than double damage (×2.1) to poisoned targets.
skill.revive_tonic.desc: Revives a fallen ally with 30% of their max HP. Can also be used from the menu.
skill.coin_barrage.desc: Hurls shrapnel at random enemies, striking 3 times in total.
skill.shove.desc: Strikes a single enemy with a 50% chance to inflict paralysis.
skill.sound_wave.desc: Emits a powerful shockwave targeting all enemies (50% hit chance per target), with a 40% chance to inflict poison.
skill.mocny_atak.desc: Delivers a powerful blow dealing 1.5× regular damage.
skill.leczenie.desc: Restores 30% HP to an ally (10% on a wrong quiz answer). Can also be used from the menu.
skill.scan.desc: Reveals the HP, stats, and description of a chosen enemy. Does not consume a turn.
skill.dual_attack.desc: The enemy strikes a hero twice in rapid succession.
skill.triple_attack.desc: The enemy attacks a hero with a series of 3 strikes.
skill.phantom_volt.desc: The enemy shocks a hero with spectral energy, with a 40% chance to silence.
skill.decay_breath.desc: The enemy breathes noxious vapors at a hero, with a 50% chance to inflict poison.
skill.poison_vine.desc: The enemy ensnares a hero with a venomous vine, with an 80% chance to inflict poison.
skill.spook_howl.desc: The enemy emits a terrifying howl at the entire party, with a 60% chance to inflict spooked.
skill.blinding_smoke.desc: The enemy shrouds a hero in smoke, with a 100% chance to inflict blind.
skill.dizzying_gaze.desc: The enemy casts a hypnotic glare at a hero, with a 100% chance to inflict confusion.
skill.toxic_gaze.desc: The enemy directs a toxic glare at a hero, with a 100% chance to inflict poison.
skill.battering_dash.desc: The enemy charges violently into a hero, dealing 1.5× normal damage.
skill.whirling_slash.desc: The enemy strikes a hero with a series of 3 whirling slashes.
skill.dark_regen.desc: The enemy channels dark energy, restoring 1,000 of its own HP.
skill.relentless_assault.desc: The enemy assaults a hero with a relentless flurry of 6 strikes.
skill.heavy_strike.desc: The enemy strikes a hero with a flurry of 4 blows, with a 25% chance to inflict paralysis.
skill.knockdown.desc: The enemy delivers a heavy knockdown blow against a hero, with a 35% chance to stun.
skill.sonic_blast.desc: The enemy blasts the entire party with a sonic shockwave, with a 30% chance to inflict confusion.
skill.timed_charge.desc: The enemy detonates a powerful explosive wave that damages the entire party.
skill.burst_swarm.desc: The enemy fires a barrage of 4 flashes at random heroes, with a 25% chance to inflict blind per hit.
skill.crushing_blow.desc: The enemy strikes a hero with a risky blow dealing 25,000 fixed damage, with a 16% chance to hit.
skill.frenzy_charge.desc: The enemy unleashes a furious rush on a hero, delivering a series of 8 strikes.
skill.venom_screech.desc: The enemy emits an ear-splitting screech at a hero, with a 40% chance to inflict poison.
status.atk_down.name: ATK Down
status.atk_down.desc: Decreases attack power by 25% for 3 turns.
status.atk_up.name: ATK Up
status.atk_up.desc: Increases attack power by 25% for 3 turns.
status.agi_down.name: AGI Down
status.agi_down.desc: Decreases agility by 25% for 3 turns — acts later in the turn.
status.agi_up.name: AGI Up
status.agi_up.desc: Increases agility by 25% for 3 turns — acts earlier in the turn.
status.bleed.name: Bleed
status.bleed.desc: Inflicts damage equal to 4% of max HP at the end of each turn for 3–4 turns.
status.blind.name: Blind
status.blind.desc: Reduces attack accuracy to 40% for 3–5 turns.
status.charm.name: Charm
status.charm.desc: Confuses the target into attacking random units; has a 50% chance to wear off when taking damage.
status.confusion.name: Confusion
status.confusion.desc: Confuses the target, causing them to attack random targets; 50% chance to break upon taking damage.
status.curse.name: Curse
status.curse.desc: Reduces magic attack and defense by 25% and drains 2% of max HP each turn.
status.def_down.name: DEF Down
status.def_down.desc: Decreases physical defense by 25% for 3 turns.
status.def_up.name: DEF Up
status.def_up.desc: Increases physical defense by 25% for 3 turns.
status.lunatic.name: Lunatic
status.lunatic.desc: Increases attack by 30% but lowers defense by 30% and forces attacks on random targets.
status.paralysis.name: Paralysis
status.paralysis.desc: Paralyzes the unit, preventing them from taking action for 2–3 turns.
status.poison.name: Poison
status.poison.desc: Inflicts damage equal to 5% of max HP each turn; persists after battle until cured.
status.provoke.name: Provoke
status.provoke.desc: Provokes the target, increasing their attack by 20% but reducing defense by 20% for 2–3 turns.
status.regen.name: Regen
status.regen.desc: Restores 5% of max HP at the end of each turn for 4 turns.
status.silence.name: Silence
status.silence.desc: Silences the unit, preventing skill usage for 3–5 turns.
status.sleep.name: Sleep
status.sleep.desc: Puts the target to sleep for 3–5 turns; waking immediately upon taking damage.
status.spooked.name: Spooked
status.spooked.desc: Reduces accuracy to 75% and lowers attack and magic defense by 15% for 2–4 turns.
status.stun.name: Stun
status.stun.desc: Stuns the target, preventing any action for 1–2 turns.
